summary: ST-04 is a story with children: [] and no workitems/ directory: an empty story, which the planning contract requires expanded before acceptance, so this is a split. Its own scope inventory confirms this is not a leaf: at least 15 distinct deliverable behaviors (5 authored spectacle beats + 4 story-delivery channels + a minimum of 3 zone reactions + a minimum of 3 environmental puzzles, growing toward ~20 with the max puzzle/contradiction/foreshadow counts) across 4 named subsystems (trigger system, world content data, creature simulation, headless scenario tests), far over the three-responsibility leaf limit; none of AC-enc-beats / AC-enc-story / AC-enc-reactions / AC-enc-puzzles currently has child coverage (coverage: false). Findings are otherwise sound: depends_on [ST-03] resolves (beats are staged around the real roster organisms ST-03 delivers), the trigger system already exists via WI-07 and must be extended not rebuilt, the four criteria form a cleanly partitionable floor, and the constraints are carried (authored-not-random per sections 61/67, no MacGuffin/ending/balance per ST-05/ST-07, foreshadow referenced by id only from the WI-01c reveal map, feeding ST-05 without owning MacGuffin mechanics). Required split: one child per parent criterion so each child owns strictly fewer parent criteria than the parent - ST-04a beats -> AC-enc-beats, ST-04b story channels (radio/fragments/props/landmarks/contradictions plus section-51 foreshadow traces) -> AC-enc-story, ST-04c world-state reactions -> AC-enc-reactions, ST-04d environmental puzzles -> AC-enc-puzzles; do not leave the node's own proposed 3-child grouping (reactions+puzzles combined) as-is unless that combined child stays within three changed responsibilities, note the beats child may need a further 2-way split (5 beats x authored timing/entrance/reaction/escape), and note the story child is the largest content block and may itself need a split between written channels (radio/fragments) and placed channels (props/landmarks/contradictions). Every child inherits depends_on [ST-03] and the WI-07 extend-don't-rebuild boundary. On cross-child proof, name an explicit final proof owner per the verification promise: the beats child owns the fresh-save scenario plus browser check that all beats fire in sequence, the story child owns the keep-or-delete audit of every fragment and the end-to-end four-channel coherence, the reactions child owns the fresh-save flag-gated reaction scenario for each altered earlier zone, and the puzzles child owns the headless scenario-harness completion proof for each puzzle; ST-05's dependency on the last foreshadow traces must remain satisfied inside ST-04, not deferred.
